zach: quick note — the cudnn bump may change latency tail slightly, we watched 95p go +12ms in staging during the canary. keeping an eye.

emma: telemetry looks fine so far in canary; KV hit rate stable. ops-oncall can you confirm alerting thresholds are green?

ops-oncall: alerts: none firing. small spike in 5xx (7 -> 9/min) during canary start, rolled back to baseline after 4 minutes. logs: `nginx: 502 x3 from model-proxy` but tracepoints show retries succeeded.

priya: if we need to rollback, prefer targeted rollback by PR: revert PR #4921 first (auth fix) then revert infra image if still bad. full rollback plan in runbook.

maria: approved for full rollout assuming no further regressions. can someone add a note to the release channel with the commit SHAs and authors?
